metadata.description: Country to major industrial, manufacturing, and logistics cities mapping
metadata.usage: Used by exposure mapper to resolve supplier locations to city-level geographic anchors for query generation

Taiwan.notes: Hsinchu is primary semiconductor manufacturing hub (TSMC, UMC)

China.notes: Shenzhen and Dongguan are primary electronics assembly hubs

Japan.notes: Nagoya and Aichi are automotive manufacturing centres; Kyoto is electronics components hub

South Korea.notes: Ulsan is automotive and petrochemical hub; Samsung HQ in Suwon/Hwaseong

United States.notes: US requires 3-5 sources due to geographic scale and economic diversity

Germany.notes: Stuttgart is automotive hub (Mercedes, Porsche); Hamburg is primary European port

India.notes: Chennai is automotive manufacturing hub; Bangalore is IT and aerospace hub

Malaysia.notes: Penang is primary semiconductor assembly and test hub in Southeast Asia

Vietnam.notes: Growing electronics manufacturing hub; Samsung produces 50%+ of phones here

Thailand.notes: Eastern seaboard is automotive and electronics manufacturing zone

Indonesia.notes: Batam is manufacturing hub near Singapore; Karawang for automotive

Singapore.notes: Global logistics and financial hub; Jurong is petrochemical cluster

Qatar.notes: Ras Laffan is world's largest LNG export facility

Saudi Arabia.notes: Jubail is largest industrial city in the world; key petrochemical hub

United Arab Emirates.notes: Jebel Ali is largest port in Middle East and one of top 10 globally

Netherlands.notes: Rotterdam is Europe's largest port; ASML in Eindhoven (semiconductor lithography)

Belgium.notes: Antwerp is second largest European port; major chemicals hub

Chile.notes: World's largest lithium and copper producer; Atacama is primary mining region

Australia.notes: Major lithium, iron ore, coal, and LNG exporter; Pilbara is primary iron ore region

DR Congo.notes: World's largest cobalt producer; Katanga province is mining centre

Zambia.notes: Major copper and cobalt producer; Copperbelt is mining heartland

Brazil.notes: Major iron ore, nickel, and rare earth producer; Manaus is electronics manufacturing zone

Mexico.notes: Major nearshoring destination; Bajio corridor is automotive hub

Turkey.notes: Kocaeli is automotive manufacturing hub (Ford, Toyota, Hyundai)

Poland.notes: Growing automotive and electronics manufacturing hub in Central Europe

France.notes: Toulouse is European aerospace hub (Airbus HQ)
